verdict.rationale: AutoGen is a multi-agent framework, so event-triggered automation rules are a fair question for it. The evidence only documents orchestration primitives: round-robin turns, model-based speaker selection, Swarm handoff messages, and GraphFlow directed graphs. None of these is a user-defined rule that fires actions automatically on events; at most they are building blocks a developer could use to construct such behavior.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
